احترمتن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَرَمْتُنَّ (iḥtaramtunna) /iħ.ta.ram.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
# اُحْتُرِمْتُنَّ (uḥturimtunna) /uħ.tu.rim.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
